description: Configuration for managing shared files during batch audit execution

sharedFiles.description: Coverage thresholds per component — merge all threshold entries
CI workflow — changes must be applied sequentially, never in parallel
Library barrel file — take union of all exports, sort alphabetically
React wrapper barrel file — take union of all exports, sort alphabetically

coverageConfig.strategy: Take the UNION of all component entries. For duplicate keys, use the LATEST value (from the most recent agent commit).

ciWorkflow.strategy: Sequential application only. Each agent reads the current state and applies changes on top. Never merge conflicting CI changes.

barrelFiles.strategy: Collect all export statements, sort alphabetically, remove duplicates.
